name: Side Step and Collect
notes: Practice variant for continuous Argentine tango sequences (2026-11-18): keep the accepted 35 cm lead-right/follow-left side step, then collect lead left/follow right on a separate Q without changing weight. Finish closed on lead right/follow left, ready for Cruzada. The original one-Q open Side Step remains available unchanged. Two explicit Q counts replace a position jump; no figure skips, crossing flags, body offsets, solver changes or altered tolerances. Provisional collection timing for subjective review.
